assignment: Sort photographer groups by a seeded SHA-256 in each phenotype stratum. Every third group enters development; all others enter audit.
domain: Independent Wikimedia Commons photographs with author and file-level attribution.
exclusion_threshold: Exact hashes and dHash at Hamming distance <=4 over all reflected and rotated orientations.
benchmark_scope: Curated stress set. Operating precision depends on this class prevalence.
